newsitem.title: USA: Nabisco to sell four regional brands.
newsitem.headline: Nabisco to sell four regional brands.

text.p: Nabisco Inc. said Monday it plans to sell four of its regional brands, with combined sales of $29 million in 1995, as part of its ongoing restructuring.
The brands, all managed by Speciality Products Co., an operating company of Nabisco, are Regina Vinegars and Cooking Wines, Wright's Liquid Smoke, Brer Rabbit Molasses and Vermont Maid Syrups.
"Each one of these brands is profitable and has a strong and loyal consumer base," said Nabisco President and Chief Executive H. John Greeniaus.
"While they don't fit with our focus on national market category leadership, we are confident that a number of potential buyers will find them highly attractive."
On June 24, Parsippany, N.J.-based Nabisco said it would restructure its operations to cut costs.
Nabisco's stock fell 62.5 cents to $38.50 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
